articles.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
articles.description: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.

articles.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
articles.description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.

articles.title: MapQuest is now the No. 1 US app after bucking Trump’s ‘Lake America’ renaming
articles.description: The once-dominant mapping app has surged to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store after refusing to adopt Trump’s “Lake America” name, drawing more than half of its 2026 U.S. downloads in just six days.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.description: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: It sure looks like hackers breached a major ID card verification service
articles.description: An identity theft search site claimed to have more than 150 million driver's license photos stolen from an ID verification service. The crime site has now shut down.

articles.description: New Jersey’s Attorney General and gaming authorities filed a petition for a writ of certiorari to the US Supreme Court over Kalshi offering sporting event contracts to residents.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.description: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election

articles.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets

articles.title: Enhanced geothermal notches another win as Google buys 400 MW from Fervo

articles.title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
